   182	    def _build_doc(self, role, path, collection, argspec, entry_point=None):
   183	        """Build documentation for a role and its selected entry points.
   184	
   185	        :returns: A tuple containing the role FQCN and its documentation, or
   186	            ``None`` for the documentation when no entry points are included.
   187	        """
   188	        if collection:
   189	            fqcn = '.'.join([collection, role])
   190	        else:
   191	            fqcn = role
   192	
   193	        doc = {
   194	            'path': path,
   195	            'collection': collection,
   196	            'entry_points': {},
   197	        }
   198	        for ep in argspec:
   199	            if entry_point is None or ep == entry_point:
   200	                doc['entry_points'][ep] = argspec[ep]
   201	
   202	        if not doc['entry_points']:
   203	            return (fqcn, None)
   204	        return (fqcn, doc)

   206	    def _create_role_list(self, roles_path, collection_filter=None):
   207	        """Return a dict describing the listing of all roles with arg specs.
   208	
   209	        :param role_paths: A tuple of one or more role paths.
   210	
   211	        :returns: A dict indexed by role name, with 'collection' and 'entry_points' keys per role.
   212	
   213	        Example return:
   214	
   215	            results = {
   216	               'roleA': {
   217	                  'collection': '',
   218	                  'entry_points': {
   219	                     'main': 'Short description for main'
   220	                  }
   221	               },
   222	               'a.b.c.roleB': {
   223	                  'collection': 'a.b.c',
   224	                  'entry_points': {
   225	                     'main': 'Short description for main',
   226	                     'alternate': 'Short description for alternate entry point'
   227	                  }
   228	               'x.y.z.roleB': {
   229	                  'collection': 'x.y.z',
   230	                  'entry_points': {
   231	                     'main': 'Short description for main',
   232	                  }
   233	               },
   234	            }
   235	        """
   236	        if not collection_filter:
   237	            roles = self._find_all_normal_roles(roles_path)
   238	        else:
   239	            roles = []
   240	        collroles = self._find_all_collection_roles(collection_filter=collection_filter)
   241	
   242	        result = {}
   243	
   244	        for role, role_path in roles:
   245	            argspec = self._load_argspec(role, role_path=role_path)
   246	            fqcn, summary = self._build_summary(role, '', argspec)
   247	            result[fqcn] = summary
   248	
   249	        for role, collection, collection_path in collroles:
   250	            argspec = self._load_argspec(role, collection_path=collection_path)
   251	            fqcn, summary = self._build_summary(role, collection, argspec)
   252	            result[fqcn] = summary
   253	
   254	        return result

   256	    def _create_role_doc(self, role_names, roles_path, entry_point=None):
   257	        """
   258	        :param role_names: A tuple of one or more role names.
   259	        :param role_paths: A tuple of one or more role paths.
   260	        :param entry_point: A role entry point name for filtering.
   261	
   262	        :returns: A dict indexed by role name, with 'collection', 'entry_points', and 'path' keys per role.
   263	        """
   264	        roles = self._find_all_normal_roles(roles_path, name_filters=role_names)
   265	        collroles = self._find_all_collection_roles(name_filters=role_names)
   266	        result = {}
   267	
   268	        for role, role_path in roles:
   269	            argspec = self._load_argspec(role, role_path=role_path)
   270	            fqcn, doc = self._build_doc(role, role_path, '', argspec, entry_point)
   271	            if doc is not None:
   272	                result[fqcn] = doc
   273	
   274	        for role, collection, collection_path in collroles:
   275	            argspec = self._load_argspec(role, collection_path=collection_path)
   276	            fqcn, doc = self._build_doc(role, collection_path, collection, argspec, entry_point)
   277	            if doc is not None:
   278	                result[fqcn] = doc
   279	
   280	        return result

Implemented `RoleMixin._build_doc` to return `(fqcn, doc)` or `(fqcn, None)` when no entry points match. `_create_role_doc` now delegates to it, preserving the document keys and input specification objects.

Added direct unit tests for filtering, FQCNs, passthrough values, and empty results. Validation passed: `PYTHONPATH=lib python -m pytest -q test/units/cli/test_doc.py` (17 passed); `git diff --check` passed.
